newsitem.title: USA: ASTEC self-tenders for 2 million shares.
newsitem.headline: ASTEC self-tenders for 2 million shares.

text.p: Astec Industries Inc said Thursday it will conduct a "Dutch Auction" self-tender offer for up to 2,000,000 shares of the company's Common Stock.
The tender, with a price range will be from $9.50 a share to $10.50 per share, will begin March 27, and expire at 1700 EST/2200 GMT May 1, unless otherwise extended.

The company said under the terms of the Dutch Auction offer Astec stockholders will be given the opportunity to specify prices within the stated price range at which they are willing to tender their shares.
